---
name: teamflow-trim
description: Remove idle teamflow workers from the running session in the current git repository, keeping workers that still have tasks. Use when the user asks to trim, clear, or dismiss idle workers, or invokes $teamflow-trim.
---

<!-- teamflow stub: generated by teamflow init, which overwrites edits -->

Run `teamflow guide teamflow-trim` and follow the instructions it prints.

If the `teamflow` command is not found, this project uses teamflow (see
`teamflow =` in `teamflow.conf` for the version it needs), but teamflow is
not installed on this machine. Recommend that the user install it:

    git clone https://github.com/jaechoidev/teamflow ~/code/teamflow
    ~/code/teamflow/scripts/teamflow install

Do not install it without the user's approval.
